description: This Java class 'DelinquencyActionParseAndValidator' handles validation and parsing of delinquency actions (pause/resume) for loans, including date validation, overlap checks, and ensuring actions are performed on active loans within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: DelinquencyActionParseAndValidator
classes.description: A validator class for parsing and validating delinquency actions (pause/resume) on loans, ensuring correct date ranges, non-overlapping periods, and active loan status.

methods.name: validateAndParseUpdate
methods.description: Validates and parses a delinquency action update request, checking loan status and date constraints based on action type.

methods.name: validateBothStartAndEndDatesAreProvided
methods.description: Ensures both start and end dates are provided for pause actions.

methods.name: validateResumeShouldBeOnActivePause
methods.description: Checks that a resume action occurs during an active pause period.

methods.name: validateResumeDoesNotExist
methods.description: Ensures no existing resume action on the same start date.

methods.name: validateResumeNoEndDate
methods.description: Validates that resume actions do not have an end date.

methods.name: validateResumeStartDate
methods.description: Checks that resume start date is the current business date.

methods.name: validatePauseStartAndEndDate
methods.description: Ensures pause period has at least one day duration.

methods.name: validatePauseStartDateNotBeforeDisbursementDate
methods.description: Validates that pause start date is after loan disbursement date.

methods.name: validateLoanIsActive
methods.description: Checks that the loan is active before applying delinquency actions.

methods.name: validatePauseShallNotOverlap
methods.description: Ensures pause periods do not overlap with existing pause periods.

methods.name: isOverlapping
methods.description: Determines if two delinquency periods overlap based on start and end dates.

methods.name: parseCommand
methods.description: Parses JSON command into a LoanDelinquencyAction object.

methods.name: extractAction
methods.description: Extracts and validates the action type (pause/resume) from JSON.

methods.name: validateActionString
methods.description: Validates that the action string is not empty.

methods.name: extractStartDate
methods.description: Extracts start date from JSON input.

methods.name: extractEndDate
methods.description: Extracts end date from JSON input.

methods.name: raiseValidationError
methods.description: Throws validation exception with message and code.
